dedupe_keys.name: atlas all the locations of all servers global data centre map dataset

description: ATLAS, short for All The Locations of All Servers, is a free downloadable list of data centre facilities around the world compiled by an independent developer who publishes under the name Ringmast4r. After removing duplicates from a raw collection of 25,757 entries, the main file lists 18,110 data centres in 116 countries run by 4,181 operators, each with facility name, operating company, street address, city, state and country, and with coordinates where they could be resolved; about 6,131 facilities, or 34 per cent, have verified coordinates. The United States accounts for 8,818 sites, followed by the United Kingdom, Germany, France and China, and the operators with most sites are Amazon Web Services, Equinix and Lumen. The data can be downloaded in twelve formats, from CSV, GeoJSON and KML to SQLite and Parquet, and explored on an interactive web map. Coverage: worldwide, current snapshot. Format and access: GitHub repository and website, free under an attribution licence. Caveats: compiled from public directories and web sources by one person; most sites lack verified coordinates, and the author warns against relying on positional precision; capacity and power are not given. Simulation uses: locating data centres for hazard exposure screening, clustering of facilities in metro hubs and interdependency with power and fibre networks. Related records: the IM3 data centre atlas covers the United States from OpenStreetMap, and Cloudscene and PeeringDB list facilities with interconnection details.
